runtimeChoice.firstCandidate: Reuse the existing bound Apps Script only after identifying its actual project, installed code and trigger creator. Source-configured SPT web-app URL is not a project identity or proof of current code.
runtimeChoice.appsScriptIdentity: A manual bound-script action runs as the user at the keyboard; an installable clock trigger runs as its creator. Neither automatically uses main-sheet-bot or the dot cloud browser session.
runtimeChoice.portability: The current reusable TypeScript code uses Bun/Node crypto/util and is not an Apps Script bundle. A small reviewed portable wrapper/port or an authenticated existing bridge is required. Do not paste it into Apps Script and claim deployment.
runtimeChoice.gcpAlternative: ganga-daechi-260927-p0723 / main-sheet-bot remains the selected existing GCP identity. Cloud Run plus Scheduler is a possible deliberate keyless runtime choice, not the default. Both projects currently have billing disabled; no billing, API enablement, IAM expansion or service deployment is authorized by this plan.
runtimeChoice.privateLedger: Choose and approve an exact teacher-only durable audit destination before student values are copied there. Hidden tabs, shared workbook properties and private-looking titles do not prove private access. Preserve draft/revision history; no secrets or raw session/media in audit logs.

remainingDecisionsAndAuthority: User completes the pending secure login handoff; independently prove actual source read afterward
Identify/review the existing bound Apps Script project and its intended trigger owner
Choose a supported unattended LMS authentication/session provider; do not extract browser cookies or invent an API
Approve exact top-row identity mapping, source field ownership and data destinations including private audit storage
Authorize actual trigger installation/OAuth expansion/deployment at the relevant setup step
If Apps Script cannot use a supported source provider, explicitly choose an alternate host and any cost/security changes

externalReferences.finding: nearMinute has plus/minus 15-minute timing; inTimezone explicitly selects the zone
Installable triggers run as the creator; each account cannot see triggers created by other accounts
New services/scopes can require explicit new authorization
Cloud Scheduler supports minute cron and explicit time zone
Cloud Run source deployment has API, build/storage and IAM requirements; it is not implied by existing Sheet bot access
